propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust the full request budget on repository tool batches without banking any criterion verdicts, violating the incremental-banking contract and returning CompletionRecoveryError instead of a normal PASS/FAIL outcome

Pydantic AI executes model response tool batches concurrently, so prompt-only instructions cannot serialize evidence collection and commit actions; dense runs defer all record calls until after budget exhaustion

A completion-only policy wrapper at the build_agent_kwargs seam must claim one governed action per response, count unique evidence responses per criterion id, and invoke record_criterion_verdict as met=false at response three if still unbanked, guaranteeing progress before exhaustion

The authoritative banking contract must be expressed in system guidance as a finite state transition (process manifest ids in order, use evidence actions, commit through record tool, advance) rather than relying on untrusted ticket context and subjective model judgment

The held-out repeated behavioral oracle confirmed zero banks at budget exhaustion under the original mechanism, 2/3-or-better bounded success plus normal verdict after policy attachment, and return to zero banks when the policy was disabled, validating the root cause and fix
